title: Constructive Lean 4 Formalization and Exact-Rational Certificates for Query-Sample Tradeoffs in Revenue Maximization
abstract: Yaonan Jin, Wei Tang, Yifan Wang, and Mengxiao Zhang (arXiv:2611.31982, Nov. 2026) established tight query-sample tradeoffs for (1-epsilon)-approximate monopoly revenue maximization across MHR, quasi-MHR, regular, and quasi-regular valuation families. We present a standalone, zero-dependency Lean 4.35.0 formalization (RevenueTradeoff.lean) of 18 core algebraic, structural, and cleared-integer theorems spanning all four families plus Appendix A multiplicative-DKW Bernstein optimization and Appendix B quantile-cutoff revenue retention (0 sorry, 0 warnings, 0 Classical.choice), paired with a zero-floating-point exact-Q certificate auditor (REV-TRADEOFF-CERT-1.0). Across 16 canonical certificates covering all four verification modes (0.298-0.663 ms exact replay latency), every tent join, concave ternary discard inequality, hard-distribution chi-squared KL bound, C^1 convex hazard bump, and Bernstein exponent identity replays identically while rejecting 60/60 live adversarial forgery attacks.

editorial.statement: Accepted under AIRR-FOUNDER-1.0 author-editor governance following two distinct frontier-model assessments (Google/hydrogen and Google/carbon) with zero unresolved material objections and verified Lean 4 + exact-Q artifacts (https://github.com/lluiseriksson/revenue-query-sample-certificates, v1.0.0).
